request.prompt:
Production hand-drawn animation sheet: EXACTLY 24 consecutive original cels, SIX columns by FOUR rows, 3072x2048 RGBA. Each cel occupies a fixed 512x512 cell, read left-to-right and then next row. True transparent alpha. No labels, frame numbers, guide circles, grid lines, paper, floor or background.

REFERENCE ROLES, in priority order:
1. Image 1 is the exact GEOMETRIC LAYOUT TEMPLATE. Use its cell centers and rising circle radii as limits, never per-cell auto-fit. Every cell center is (256,256). Paint inside each indicated envelope; remove the template's white background and every gray line completely.
2. Image 2 is a SIX-POSE MOTION STUDY. Its first two poses teach the small head strokes and tight curled tails needed throughout the FIRST EIGHT cels. Its later poses teach tails unfurling and curves opening, for later cels only. Do not copy its different fragment positions, counts, broad feather shoulders or wrong occupied size. It provides ACTION DEVELOPMENT, not the final composition.
3. Image 3 is the approved MATURE ENDPOINT, at radius220. Its forty cyan/gold independent arc identities, clockwise color order, nearby inner/outer lanes and staggered gaps define where each stroke eventually settles. It is ONLY THE END OF THE ACTION. Never copy this mature ring at a smaller size into the early cels.

ACTION: many tiny living brushstroke heads flow outward, curl independently, pull growing tails behind them, open their hooks and only later develop the pointed notches and forked tails of the approved endpoint. These are 24 genuinely different hand-painted keyframes. Their changing centerline curvature, head-to-tail length ratio, head width, fork opening and internal highlight are the motion. A tiny completed mature ring getting larger is explicitly wrong. The runtime supplies the overall circular rotation, so the sheet's compass orientation remains stable while each stroke curls and flows locally.

ROW 1, cels0–5: cel0 is fully empty transparent. From cel1 tiny simple cyan/gold head marks appear around the growing circular perimeter. Short round-to-pointed commas open into tight C curls. Every future long blade has a MISSING shoulder and MISSING long tail. Every future fork has NO fork yet. No mature scythe silhouettes, no pointed multi-prong weapons, no zigzag shoulders, no long thin spearheads. At cel5 the heads still carry only a very short bent tail. Neighboring heads start at slightly different times. Keep a central hole and transparent gaps between all separate heads. Envelopes: 0,32,42,54,66,78 pixels.

ROW 2, cels6–11: for cels6–7 KEEP the short tight-head stage: no mature long blades or forked shoulders. Starting in cel8, each head pulls a newly drawn long soft tail behind itself. C curls loosen into asymmetric S curves; hooks open, head width and tail width change independently. Only the last two cels in this row begin small unequal tail splits. The future long upper cyan blade is still a curved thin ribbon, NOT the approved zigzag blade scaled down. The lower gold crescent is still an opening bent comma, NOT the complete mature crescent. Envelopes:91,104,116,128,140,151.

ROW 3, cels12–17: individually drawn ribbons lengthen, thin tails change bend direction as they lag their heads, and fork branches gradually develop. Some hooks remain curled while neighboring strips already open into swept arcs. Angular shoulders, notches and sharp mature tips gradually appear. Color and lane identity remain tied to the final reference; no new runes or decorations. Two neighboring broken peripheral lanes and their offset gaps become clear. Envelopes:162,172,181,190,198,204.

ROW 4, cels18–23: each strip eases toward its own EXACT mature pose in image3, with tail tips and shoulders still changing shape during the settling. Outer drift decelerates. The last three drawings have only small local settling differences and no size jump. Cel23 is the approved reference at the template scale. Envelopes:210,214,217,219,220,220.

Critical identity and separation: track the same strips continuously, preserving cyan/gold color, clockwise order and inner/outer lane. Do not inherit the study's alternate feather composition. At every stage all independent strips retain visible transparent air: never touch, cross, overlap, cover, merge or move through a neighbor. Forks within one strip are allowed; separate strips must remain separate. There is no filled disk or spokes across the empty center. No purple, diamonds, runes, glow cloud or unrelated particles.

Style: the approved Don't Starve Together hand-inked world FX, charcoal tapered irregular contours, clear simple cyan/gold planes and small painted pale highlights that change shape with the stroke. No geometric-vector arc copying, no photographic texture, no motion blur. Remove all template lines and white background. Real transparent margins, central holes and spaces between strips in all 24 cells. Do not resize a completed painted ring to simulate this animation.
